# Price a bar service event without guessing

> Price a mobile bar or bartending event: bartenders needed, drinks, staffing with call minimums, supplies and travel, your walk-away floor, price per guest, and whether a client's per-head ask makes money. Free, private, runs in your browser; CLI included.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
